title: Systems lab
subtitle: Five systems. One workspace inside this repository. Explore each original implementation.

tools.description: Query the original slotted-page and B+ tree engine. One statement per request.

fields.label: Your message

tools.description: Search the educational catalog, or add live Wikipedia results.

tools.description: Compile C into real x86-64 assembly with this repository’s minic compiler.

actions.label: Compile to assembly
